<title>5 Day Snow Kiting Tour | APEX Kitesurfing</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Ready for an unforgettable snow kiting adventure? Join us for an exclusive, all-inclusive tour to Kosciuszko, New South Wales. Spend your days perfecting your skills on the snow, with the stunning backcountry of Kosciuszko National Park.
Your Snow Kiting Experience
You'll stay in the cozy mountain town of Jindabyne, and each morning you'll board the APEX alpine transport for a scenic ride to Thredbo or Charlotte Pass. Our KA-certified instructors will be with you every step of the way, whether you're a complete beginner learning the basics or an experienced rider looking to master new skills. We'll spend the day kiting the backcountry of the resort's boundary, where the wind and wide-open terrain create the perfect conditions.
After an exhilarating day on the snow, you'll head back to your comfortable and warm twin-share accommodation in Jindabyne. In the evenings, you will enjoy dinning out at some of Jindabyne's prestige restaurants joined by fellow tour guests to sharing stories and making new friends.
What's Included
Our goal is to make your trip as seamless and enjoyable as possible. The tour price includes everything you need for a safe and epic experience on the snow:
Return airport transfers from Canberra Airport (CBR)
Twin-share accommodation in Jindabyne
Alpine and over snow transport to and from ski resorts each day
Lift passes and backcountry permits
Safety equipment, including an avalanche beacon, shovel, and all mandatory backcountry survival gear
KA-certified instruction
An Apex outer shell and jacket to keep you warm and protected
Try and buy packages and hire packages available for additional fees. 
Please contact Apex Kitesurfing to discuss these additional options. 
Don't miss this chance to combine the thrill of snow kiting with the stunning beauty of the Australian Alps."/>

spots</p></div></div><div class="sOMZnbk oTZu_Li---alignment-4-left" data-section-type="DESCRIPTION"><hr data-hook="section-divider" class="s__4kNYQU ofdGAeA---direction-10-horizontal sW_eZPV"/><div data-hook="children-DESCRIPTION" class="sydKowG"><div data-hook="description-wrapper"><h2 class="sLoPao4 onEzxJb---typography-11-runningText onEzxJb---priority-7-primary siptXFP o_IUGOz---location-4-BODY" aria-hidden="false" data-hook="description-title">Description</h2><p class="sLoPao4 onEzxJb---typography-11-runningText onEzxJb---priority-7-primary sPHZGGF oNKl38p---location-4-BODY sF_NA_j" aria-hidden="false" data-hook="description">Ready for an unforgettable snow kiting adventure? Join us for an exclusive, all-inclusive tour to Kosciuszko, New South Wales. Spend your days perfecting your skills on the snow, with the stunning backcountry of Kosciuszko National Park.
Your Snow Kiting Experience
You&#x27;ll stay in the cozy mountain town of Jindabyne, and each morning you&#x27;ll board the APEX alpine transport for a scenic ride to Thredbo or Charlotte Pass. Our KA-certified instructors will be with you every step of the way, whether you&#x27;re a complete beginner learning the basics or an experienced rider looking to master new skills. We&#x27;ll spend the day kiting the backcountry of the resort&#x27;s boundary, where the wind and wide-open terrain create the perfect conditions.
After an exhilarating day on the snow, you&#x27;ll head back to your comfortable and warm twin-share accommodation in Jindabyne. In the evenings, you will enjoy dinning out at some of Jindabyne&#x27;s prestige restaurants joined by fellow tour guests to sharing stories and making new friends.
What&#x27;s Included
Our goal is to make your trip as seamless and enjoyable as possible. The tour price includes everything you need for a safe and epic experience on the snow:
Return airport transfers from Canberra Airport (CBR)
Twin-share accommodation in Jindabyne
Alpine and over snow transport to and from ski resorts each day
Lift passes and backcountry permits
Safety equipment, including an avalanche beacon, shovel, and all mandatory backcountry survival gear
KA-certified instruction
An Apex outer shell and jacket to keep you warm and protected
Try and buy packages and hire packages available for additional fees. 
Please contact Apex Kitesurfing to discuss these additional options. 
Don&#x27;t miss this chance to combine the thrill of snow kiting with the stunning beauty of the Australian Alps.</p></div></div></div><div class="sOMZnbk oTZu_Li---alignment-4-left
